استنقذا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْقَذَا (istanqaḏā) /is.tan.qa.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اُسْتُنْقِذَا (ustunqiḏā) /us.tun.qi.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اِسْتَنْقِذَا (istanqiḏā) /is.tan.qi.ðaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
